articles.summary: TORONTO, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Satellos Bioscience Inc. (NASDAQ: MSLE, TSX: MSCL) , a clinical-stage drug development company developing life-improving medicines to treat degenerative muscle diseases, today announced that management will participate in the following investor conferences in September. 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference Date: Wednesday, September 9, 2026 Presentation: 3:55 p.m. EDT Location: New York, NY Webcast: here H.C. Wainwright 28 th Annual Global Investment Conference Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 Fireside chat: 9 a.m. EDT Location: New York, NY Webcast: here Members of the Satellos leadership team will be available for one-on-one investor meetings during both conferences. Replays of the presentations will be available in the Events and Presentations section of the Company’s website, www.satellos.com .
